insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for unfulfilled orders. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update applies to orders modified through the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware of this change, as it may affect their app's tax calculation logic. They should test their apps to ensure compatibility with the updated tax recalculation behavior. Additionally, developers should review their code to handle any potential tax calculation discrepancies. The GraphQL Admin API version 2026-10 includes this change, so developers should ensure they are using the correct API version.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate tax calculations, reducing potential errors and discrepancies. This change will help merchants comply with tax regulations and improve their overall customer experience.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to avoid potential financial losses and ensure compliance with tax laws. This change improves the overall reliability and accuracy of the Shopify platform, making it more trustworthy for merchants and their customers.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
The Shopify CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, enhancing the development experience.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, enhancing the flexibility of cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed, simplifying inventory management.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing for the deployment of Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enhancing order management capabilities.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, making it more achievable for apps to meet the requirements.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated, adding new capabilities to the toolkit and extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
The Shopify CLI version 4.6.0 has removed deprecated draftable extension processes and added flags to avoid prompts in app config linking.

recap.headline: Shopify updates bring new insights and dev tools

themes.title: ShopifyQL Enhancements
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query insights on behalf of authorized merchants. This update expands the capabilities of the GraphQL Admin API. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now accessible, providing more detailed performance data.

themes.title: Development Tools
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. This improvement enhances the development experience for Hydrogen, Remix, and React Router apps, particularly when working with Checkout UI extensions and Polaris.
